That makes 12 cun = 0.246 m in y (0.2524 m along the forearm axis, which leans about 13° forward), so 1 cun = 0.0205 m in y. 5 cun gives y≈0.9325. The marker at y 0.934 is 5.02 cun in y (5.1 cun along the axis), within 0.1 cun. Transverse: in a horizontal section of the muscle meshes at y 0.934, FCR (FMA38460) spans x -0.2435 to -0.2224 and PL (FMA38463) spans -0.2226 to -0.2176. Front rays at that level hit FCR up to x=-0.224 and PL from x=-0.222, so the PL/FCR groove is at x≈-0.223. The new right marker at x=-0.2225 is inside that groove, and its surfacePoint z 0.0232 matches the skin ray hit (z 0.0231 at x -0.2225). The old marker (-0.2551, 0.936) was radial to FCR, over the radial head of FDS and the radius, so the move fixes the side-of-tendon error. The muscle close-up shows the gold dot in the furrow just medial to the broad FCR belly. The left marker (0.2225, 0.934, 0.0254) mirrors the right one. Caveat: on this BodyParts3D body the PL/FCR interval runs obliquely, from x≈-0.254 at the wrist (y 0.835) to -0.2225 at y 0.934 and -0.2155 at y 0.96. So the marker is about 2.3 cm (about 1.1 cun) medial of a straight PC7-PC3 line, which would put it at x≈-0.245 at this level. WHO defines the point by the tendons, so the tendon interval is the correct reference here.
points.neighbours: Proximal-distal order holds: PC7 y 0.831 < PC6 0.8799 < PC5 0.899 < PC4 0.934 < PC3 1.0771, with no overlap (PC4-PC5 3D distance 4.8 cm). Measured from the wrist crease, PC6 sits at 2.4 cun (standard 2) and PC5 at 3.3 cun (standard 3). The transverse alignment is broken by the unmoved neighbours. PC5 (-0.255, 0.899) lies radial to FCR (FCR lateral edge -0.2483 at y 0.90; PL/FCR interval -0.2328). PC6 (-0.253, 0.8799) is also radial to FCR (FCR lateral edge -0.2511 at y 0.88; interval -0.2392). So the PC line now jogs 3.25 cm medially between PC5 and PC4, and this jog is visible on the skin close-up. PC7 (-0.26, 0.831) also sits on the FCR tendon (FCR spans -0.261 to -0.2559 at y 0.835) rather than in the interval at -0.254, about 0.6 cm radial. For reference only, the interval positions measured with front rays are: PC5 at 3 cun ≈ [-0.235, 0.8925, skin z 0.0285]; PC6 at 2 cun ≈ [-0.242, 0.872, skin z 0.0313].
